title: Motion tween does not interpolate skewX/skewY
description: TweenTarget has no skewX/skewY fields, and displayObjectToTweenTarget() never extracts them. During a motion tween, skewX/skewY from startObj is spread back unchanged, so an object tweened from skew=0 to skew=45 stays at skew=0 on every intermediate frame. Fix: add skewX/skewY to TweenTarget in packages/core/src/tween/types.ts, extract them in displayObjectToTweenTarget() in timeline-query.ts, add lerp calls in interpolateTween(), and apply them back in the getTweenedFrame return.
